issues.title: Disconnected outgoing message elements
issues.description: Outgoing user message bubble is detached from its corresponding avatar and footer.
issues.evidence: Avatar 'أ' sits on the far left edge while the dark message bubble is pushed toward the right with wide empty space in between.
issues.suggestion: Group outgoing avatar, bubble, and status footer cohesively aligned to the start or end side.
issues.triageNote: Verified live in headless browser: align-less Bubble defaults to items-start, so inside Message align=end its w-fit content hugs inline-start — in RTL the far right edge, ~171px from the avatar/footer which sit at the end (left) side; Message's own flex-row-reverse/items-end geometry is correct and mirrors properly, root cause is missing align inheritance for child Bubbles (same flaw visible in LTR demos). Fixed via CSS inheritance in MessageContent + exported MessageAlignContext + explicit align=end in demos.
